user_request: Revois les assets. Le corps des canons est ultra bizarre. La tige du perrier a l'air fausse. La longueur du canon de 3 livres est... En fait, ça va. Le canon de 3 livres, ça va. Par contre le canon de 6 livres est un peu courbé sur le côté, ce qui est bizarre.
scope: Three cog armament equipment icons. The approved cog hull icons were integrated separately; this new batch is preview only.
charter: Native Victoria 3 painted embossed miniature UI glyphs; bronze, silver and gold progression. One characteristic weapon symbolizes each four-piece battery.

entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1: edit target, bronze swivel gun UI icon.
Correct only the weapon geometry and mount connection, preserving the warm bronze painted embossed game-icon style, composition, short gunwale fragment, transparent background and small-scale simplicity. The gun body must be a simple STRAIGHT turned cylindrical barrel tapering smoothly from breech to muzzle, all reinforcement rings and bore coaxial. No bent nozzle, stepped off-axis neck or bloated lumps. Redraw the rear aiming tiller as ONE SHORT STRAIGHT thin iron bar fixed securely to the underside of the breech; no long spoon shape, kinked pole or floating attachment. The vertical pivot must be one plain narrow cylindrical pin inserted into a small socket in the gunwale; above it a simple symmetric U-shaped fork supporting the two opposite barrel trunnions at the SAME longitudinal position. Coherent connections, perspective and mechanical axis. Preserve the upright swivel silhouette, no wheels or sled. Keep all parts in the existing bronze palette, no text, no scenery, no halo or bloom. Genuine transparent background with opaque artwork interiors. Center complete object with padding. This is a miniature PM/equipment glyph, not a detailed realistic engineering drawing.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE small Victoria 3 naval designer COG ARMAMENT equipment UI icon.
Input image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: native painted embossed bronze/silver/gold monochrome metal glyphs, thin dark bevel outline and restrained broad shading.
Primary request: one representative naval defensive gun and its characteristic MOUNTING, symbolizing a four-piece defensive battery on a cog transport. Not a complete ship, realistic painting or detailed technical plan. View three-quarter isometric from slightly above. A few big shapes readable at 32px. The MOUNT type must radically change the silhouette from the other tiers, not merely grow the tube. Complete centered glyph with generous margins.
Materials: ALL metal and wooden mount parts in ONE metallic tier palette. Genuine transparent background and blank gaps; solid opaque artwork interiors. NO halo, bloom, haze, aura, surrounding shadow, scenic backdrop or vignette. No natural brown wood on silver/gold icons.
Avoid: people, text, number labels, ammunition pile, extra scenery, entire hull, modern steel weapons, engines, overly detailed engineering diagrams, several duplicated cannons obscuring the mount.
MID tier cool blue-gray SILVER: ONE LONG light naval cannon on a compact FOUR-WHEEL WOODEN TRUCK CARRIAGE. TWO large simple wheels clearly visible on near side and rear wheels subtly visible behind, raised carriage cheeks flank the trunnion. Long slender forward barrel horizontal-diagonal, small rear cascabel. Dominant silhouette low wheeled carriage with visible round truck wheels and long projection, not a pivot post and not a sliding skid. No rail, no floor plate. One emblematic cannon for the four-piece defensive battery.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 edit target gold carronade equipment glyph. Change ONLY the distorted gun tube and the background alpha; keep the sliding carriage geometry and palette. Redraw barrel as a simple short straight cylinder with smoothly tapered body and TWO narrow reinforcement rings. Remove the pinched neck just behind the muzzle: continue the STRAIGHT barrel axis without any side bend, the muzzle center on the same axis as the breech. Muzzle is a THIN lip, not a huge flared trumpet bell or bulb, with an elliptical hole perpendicular to the axis. One continuous rigid gun body, no segmented curving body. Preserve the short broad carronade proportions and 3/4 view. Crucially DELETE ALL diffuse GOLDEN GLOW surrounding the gun and mount. The entire space outside the crisp silhouette must be truly fully transparent, not a translucent golden fog. No glow, aura, blur, external drop shadow, ground or background. Preserve solid opaque golden-painted embossed artwork interiors. No text. Small readable PM icon, not a photorealistic technical scene.

preceding_edit.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1: edit target, gold carronade on a sliding bed UI icon.
Correct the crooked barrel ONLY, and remove the unwanted external glow. Preserve the existing low long sliding carriage, two projecting straight guide rails, elevation screw, general composition, short broad carronade silhouette and monochrome muted metallic GOLD painted embossed UI-icon style. Redraw the gun as ONE STRAIGHT short slightly tapered cylinder. Its breech, body, reinforcement bands, muzzle rim and dark bore share EXACTLY ONE straight longitudinal axis. The near and far outlines are straight generatrices with a smooth modest taper. All circular bands are ellipses in parallel planes perpendicular to the same barrel axis. The muzzle must not turn sideways or bend away from the breech. Avoid bulbous irregular segmentation and off-axis rings. Three-quarter view from slightly above, mechanically coherent perspective matching the unchanged mount. No wheels, no additional gun, no labels, no scene, no halo, no aura, no bloom, no drop shadow outside the object. Genuine transparent background and gaps, solid artwork interiors. Complete centered glyph with margins; readable at 32px, not a realistic painting or technical plan.

qa.visual_inspection: Revised full-size images and 180px/64px/32px comparison inspected. Shorter regular swivel tiller and smoother straight gun body. Carronade pinched neck removed and tube axis aligned. Silver 3-pounder preserved byte-for-byte.
qa.limitations: Diffuse gold halo remains despite two edit instructions removing it. Original generated alpha preserved; no external painting or alpha retouch. Many partially transparent pixels. Illustrative UI glyphs, not certified historical plans.

integration_note: Approved revision integrated: bronze v2, unchanged silver and gold v3. Only three runtime icon bindings replaced; no stats, recipes, technology or fleet changes. Original generated alpha, including approved gold halo, preserved.
